text:
priya: quick heads-up — new int4 bring-up on q6b showed a weird spike in 'partial-answer' hallucinations for multi-turn context-append templates. dropping initial notes here.

ash: can you share the sweep id + sampling criteria? curious if sampling pulled too many longctx examples.

priya: sweep: sweep-2026-03-22-q6b-int4-v3. sampled 6k from promptset-beta, stratified by length but we had a config bug that underweighted longctx by 3x.

noah: that bug could explain mismatch vs earlier runs. also FYI: tokenizer 2.1 changes punctuation normalization which alters fuzzyhash outputs.

maya: we ran dedupe with simple sha1(raw) earlier. switching to normalize->unicode_nfc->collapse_space->lower -> fuzzyhash reduced collisions but created new near-duplicate groups.

sam: labelops: we can carve a microgold of 250 prioritized longctx samples. need final IDs and a reason tag (regression/triage) to bump queue priority.

labelops-bot: note: queue 13 has limited capacity today due to Golden Refresh. ETA to accept new microgold: 18h.

eva: i'll take the first 50 examples for manual triage (halluc vs truncation vs token-misalignment). post them to /artifacts/triage/q6b_int4_50.csv?

priya: posted 50 -> /artifacts/triage/q6b_int4_50.csv. many look like half-responses where final tokens drop off.

ash: could be kv-cache eviction mismatch + quantized attention math. eng-runtime, any recent kernel changes? @eng-runtime-bot

eng-runtime-bot: recent rollout: fastfused-attn v1.2 deployed 2026-03-18 to dedicated pools. No kernel changes since. Known issue: prefix-caching + int4 has flaky kv indexing on long sequences (investigating).

noah: ok that aligns. can we rerun a targeted 500-sample sweep with prefix-caching disabled and tokenizer_rev pinned to 2.0 to isolate variables?

maya: yes — will emit sample list after dedupe-normalize pass. proposing we also add metadata flags: longctx=true, tokenizer_rev=2.0, sampling_version=3b.

priya: sounds good. plan: 1) maya -> run normalize+fuzzy dedupe (owner: maya) 2) ash -> run no-cache 500-sample sweep (owner: ash) 3) eva -> triage 50 (owner: eva) 4) sam -> reserve microgold 250 and schedule labelers (owner: sam) 5) noah -> add tokenizer_rev fields to pipeline (owner: noah).

sam: reserving 2 labelers for microgold, ETA confirmation by 15:30 PT. will mark priority=high.

maya: uploaded deduped list -> /artifacts/curation/q6b_int4_dedupe_v2.csv (500 ids). included longctx flag.

ash: kicked off no-cache sweep (id: qc-no-cache-3841240033). will paste quick metrics when done.

ash: quick metrics: no-cache run shows overall answer completeness improved; partial-answer rate decreased from 4.7% -> 1.1% on the 500 sample subset. latency slightly up (~5ms).

eva: triage results: of our 50, 38 were partial-answer due to token alignment; 7 were genuine hallucinations (fabricated facts), 5 unclear. tagging as halluc_type=align and halluc_type=factual.

noah: pushing tokenizer_rev and sampling_version to metadata in repo. also added a small test to ensure dedupe hash uses normalized form going forward.

priya: good. decision: we'll block onboarding until we can confirm no-cache + normalized dedupe run reduces regressions to <2% on rerank/recall metrics. if that passes, we may accept int4 with a canary tag and fallback to int8 for longctx.

eng-runtime-bot: FYI: created ticket RT-8723 to track kv-cache indexing bug with int4+prefix-caching. assigned to infra/runtime.

sam: microgold reserved and pushed to label queue (#13) with high priority. expected label completion 22-03T18:40Z.

priya: thanks all. i'll open a short PR summarizing experiments and link artifacts + RT-8723. tagging @infra/runtime and @product-evals for visibility. :thumbsup:
